title: Error Handling and Exception Safety
learningObjectives: Explain the main rules of exception safety guarantees.
Identify the key C++ constructs used for exception safety guarantees.
Apply exception safety guarantees in a small program.
Recognize common failure cases and safety concerns.
Test a practical scenario and justify the chosen approach.

understand.concept: The basic guarantee leaves an object valid but possibly changed. The strong guarantee leaves observable state unchanged if an operation fails. The no-throw guarantee promises no exception escapes. Validate and prepare changes before committing.
understand.whyItMatters: Exception safety keeps state consistent and recoverable after failure.

practise.guidedTask: Implement a balance transfer: validate account IDs and amount, compute temporary balances, verify sufficient funds, then commit both. A rejected transfer must leave balances unchanged.
practise.independentTask: Refactor an update function to provide the strong guarantee using a prepared temporary and a final commit. Describe failure cases.
